scenes.label: 01 / THE PROBLEM
scenes.speech: For small online merchants, a chargeback starts a race to assemble records. The order, delivery history, customer messages, and response policy sit in different places. Rebuttal brings those records together, recommends a response, and drafts evidence for review. The goal is less manual case assembly, with the merchant retaining control of consequential decisions.

output_lines.text: Proposed response and evidence for review

scenes.reveal_timing: Editorial visualization; not original execution timing

scenes.label: 02 / HOW IT WORKS
scenes.tag: AWS STRANDS AGENTS SDK / APPLICATION DESIGN
scenes.speech: Rebuttal uses the AWS Strands Agents SDK. After intake, four agents collect evidence in parallel. Strategy waits for all four. The drafter then receives both the evidence and the proposed response. A separate executor uses an approval hook before taking a guarded action.

output_lines.text: Strategy waits for all four collectors
Executor pauses when approval is required
